answer: Sponsored admission with reputation decay stops fakes. A newcomer joins only if a sponsor stakes 20 units and it earns a jade seal through verified work. Standing decays 10% each idle epoch, so a rented name fades before voting. If it cheats, the sponsor is slashed too, deterring a gale of clones. Forging 1,000 identities costs 20,000 units locked; one honest agent pays 20 and keeps undiluted rewards. This is no fable; it prices fakery out.
